laneComparison: The audited Xiangling and Yaoyao source files listed above are byte-identical between classic and Stellar pre-118 roots; private source patches are byte-identical. No lane-specific gameplay branch was found in this scope.

sites.scopeNotes: Spawn is the existing +13-frame Core task. Trigger is wrapped exactly at each existing timer branch 103/203/303/403 because panda.Tick invokes Gadget.Tick before the custom breath branch; generic Gadget.OnThinkInterval does not enclose it. Actual queue uses the original AttackInfo, snapshot, 60-degree fan pattern, callbacks, and damage delay 10. Count is variable 0..4 based on entity tick/lifetime, with source native tickCount proof; A4 chili callback adds the existing active-character ATK modifier; it is not part of the Guoba attack scope and remains outside.

sites.thinkCadence: first native think interval 29 frames; subsequent 60 frames
sites.scopeNotes: Each scheduled native jump producer records actual 0/1 at the existing status/max-three gate and binds only the actual AddGadget object by target key. Q-born jumping Yuegui ai is initialized from burstRadishAI, so already-scheduled flight callbacks retain Burst AI after Q removal. The common radish emitter is used by E and Q; ownership is exact entity birth. E-born throwing Yuegui can independently select Radish (Burst) while Q is active; these remain E-owned and are excluded from Q-born totals. Q removes its jump entities at 360 frames or on swap; already queued character-clock flights remain independently observed by task ID.

sites.abilityName: Radish (Burst) when captured mode fact is 1
sites.scopeNotes: A1 ticks every 36 character-clock frames while Q remains active and the current action state is DashState or JumpState; a single existing enemy-area selector may return nil and then no radish is scheduled. For positive branches, existing selected target and current-status mode are not recomputed. Each flight producer records the existing Burst-vs-Skill status branch once, so delayed output after Q removal is not mislabeled.

branchFacts.0: Q status inactive at ticker entry; terminal and no children
branchFacts.1: Q active but native player state is not Dash or Jump; next ticker child only
branchFacts.2: native Dash or Jump and original target selector returned nil; next ticker child only
branchFacts.3: native Dash or Jump and original selector returned an enemy; next ticker child plus one radish-flight child

flightModeFacts.0: Q status inactive when original delayed flight callback chooses AttackInfo; queued Skill-mode radish
flightModeFacts.1: Q status active when original delayed flight callback chooses AttackInfo; queued Burst-mode radish

excludedInteractions: E-born Yaoyao throwing Yuegui whose getInfos sees active Q and selects burstRadishAI is retained under E birth identity; not a Q-born entity and excluded from Q total.
Xiangling A4 chili pickup adds an ATK modifier and is not Guoba damage.
validation: Private source patches were gofmt-formatted and default git apply --check passed against both frozen roots. No build or tests were run.

nativeReceiptFieldsRequired.ownedEntity: tickCount, incremented once at actual combat gadget Tick entry for the exact registered target key
nativeReceiptFieldsRequired.ownedEntityProducer: taskId, binding existing character-clock scheduled flight task without converting it to Core-clock delay
nativeReceiptFieldsRequired.guobaTrigger: kind=think; siteId=xiangling.skill.guoba.think; direct source wrap at timer-selected p.breath call
